title: Polenta Pie with Okra and Cheese
subtitle: cheesy polenta base with roasted okra and parmesan
description: A cheesy polenta base topped with pan-fried okra, red onion, cherry tomatoes and parmesan shavings, baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C and grease a 20 cm square baking dish.

Bring the milk (or water) to the boil in a wide pot. Season with garlic, salt and pepper, add the polenta and stir for 2-3 minutes over medium heat. Add the grated cheese and chopped spring onion and stir for another minute.
Transfer the polenta to the greased dish and smooth it, shaping it with a spoon to form an even layer on the base and sides.
Heat the olive oil and oregano leaves in a large pan and saute the okra, sliced red onion and sliced chilli with salt and pepper for 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Scatter the vegetables over the polenta, pressing them in slightly. Top with halved cherry tomatoes and shaved parmesan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden. Rest for about 10 minutes, then slice and serve.
